title: Configurable backends: config types, SandboxHostService adaptations, capability negotiation
description:
Implement configurable infrastructure backends from docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add02.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md, docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add01.md

Key deliverables:
- Config types: StorageBackend enum (zfs/local-disk), ContainerRuntime enum (gvisor/none)
- Updated ServiceConfig with backend-specific fields, SessionsRootDir for local-disk
- Constructor validation: fail if ZFS configured but ZFSManager nil, same for gVisor
- SandboxHostService adaptations for all 4 backend combinations
- SandboxHostService.Capabilities() public method
- Dynamic Capabilities() on NativeSandboxEnvironment (derived from config)
- Remove NativeSandboxCapabilities package var
- Capability negotiation: CreateSessionResponse includes ServerCapabilities
- Session-ID path-safety validation for local-disk
- Unit tests for all 4 config combinations

AC: All 4 backend combinations work, capability negotiation catches mismatches, path-safety prevents traversal, existing tests pass.
